{{Top|leg}}
A '''junieuw''' was a fiefdom controlled by various [[Krikthasi]] tribes. Each controlled an area of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baralou]]'s [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], and was ruled by an [[osi]], the most powerful warrior in the territory. The most powerful junieuw was [[Undrarian]], led by Osi [[Hass]], and they were rivalled by the [[Reterri]] and the [[Winsallu]].
